events.summary: Hello and happy Friday, wanderers!We wanted to give you a heads up: we're doing some changes that require us to temporarily close Steam open playtest sign-ups. Starting September 14, sign-ups will be closed to new participants.Don't worry - this won't have any impact on you if the game is already installed on your device or added to your Steam library!
